name: com.pipeyield/search-term-review
title: Pipeyield
description: Google Ads search terms review for Claude: estimated wasted spend and negative keywords to add.

tools.name: start_review
tools.description: Starts a free Google Ads search-term review by Pipeyield. Returns an upload link (it works for 24 hours) where the user uploads their Google Ads search terms report on Pipeyield's page, and a grant for get_review. Takes no arguments: the file never goes through the chat.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Gets the review for a grant from start_review. Answers one of: waiting (not uploaded yet), working (call again in about 30 seconds), done (the finished review, to show the user as it is) or expired (call start_review for a new link).

brief.description: Set true for the short answer: the headline and the paste-ready list only.
